snippet.title: Under the Skin (Capcom) - PS2 Game Trailer [High Quality]
snippet.description:
High quality trailer of Under the Skin/Meiwaku Seijin: Panikku Mēkā, developed by Capcom and released in 2004 for Playstation 2.

Source: Official Playstation Magazine (OPM) bonus DVD.
